calls.video_title: Invest....(but where?). Everything is falling: Gold, Nifty, AI Stocks
calls.thesis: Gold is at its support zone, so it is a good time to top up for investors who already trust gold as a diversifier uncorrelated to equities
calls.base_case: Top up at support as part of a diversified allocation; no expectation it runs from tomorrow
calls.bull_case: Support holds and gold resumes its rally from the consolidation zone
calls.bear_case: Support breaks and gold keeps falling after the recent chase-and-drop
calls.note: Framed as a top-up at support for investors who trust gold, not a fresh allocation for everyone; his own action: topping up 'a little bit'. No Rs price stated; caption's '3500 3600' figure carries no clear currency and is not recorded as a price.

calls.video_title: 44 Mins That Could Change How You Invest in This Market Correction | Rahul Jain G2G
calls.thesis: Guest: gold (and silver) falling with no base built yet — stays on radar only, no entry until base building; prefers cash meanwhile
calls.base_case: Base builds and a trigger lifts gold
calls.bull_case: A sudden trigger drives a sharp rise
calls.bear_case: No base forms and the fall continues

calls.video_title: Where to Invest and where NOT TO? - Indian stocks vs US stocks vs Gold vs FDs  - Rahul Jain
calls.thesis: No clear bullish pattern; under pressure while US bond yields stay ~5%, and a possible Indian import-duty cut (15% to 6%) could lower domestic prices
calls.bull_case: US bond yields fall toward 4-4.5% and long-term bullish trend resumes
calls.bear_case: Yields rise to ~5.5-5.7% and gold drops further as bonds win flows
